description: This file defines a final class 'Constants' that contains several public static final String constants used throughout a quiz application, particularly in a companion app for Android Wear. The class includes constant keys for intents, data passing, and paths related to quiz events.

classes.name: Constants
classes.description: A utility class holding string constants used as keys and paths in the quiz app to ensure consistency across different components.
